issue_context.title: Plex integration broken after resetting Plex account password
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After the recent Plex hack, I reset my Plex account password and chose the option to sign out all locations. After doing this, the Plex integration in Home Assistant has stopped working. 

The integration on the Integrations page lists the error:
`Retrying setup: (422) unprocessable_entity; https://plex.tv/users/account <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <errors> <error>Invalid token</error> </errors>`
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/952387/187323006-9a3434b3-8211-4508-a37f-39d7168b01cf.png)

Clicking the `Configure` button will result in the error message:
` Config flow could not be loaded: undefined `

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.8.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.8.6

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Plex

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
This set of logs is repeated every ~70-80 seconds:
2022-08-29 20:41:15.454 ERROR (SyncWorker_2) [homeassistant.components.plex.server] Not authorized to access plex.tv with provided token
2022-08-29 20:41:15.456 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.plex] Login to REDACTED failed, verify token and SSL settings: [(422) unprocessable_entity; https://plex.tv/users/account <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <errors>   <error>Invalid token</error> </errors> ]
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments: @jjlawren - Apologies for the direct tag but I think I missed something when creating this issue and the Github bot didn't tag it properly as `integration: plex`. Can you take a look at this since you're the code owner for Plex?

Hey there @jjlawren, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`plex`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L828) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

I had the same issue. The token used by the integration is no longer good and you need a new one. Delete the integration and then re-add it. The integration gets a new token during instillation. Now it is working properly again.

I believe it stayed the same but I can't say for sure. I only have a couple of Node Red flows for Roku to access different shows in Plex and they still work. I don't have anything that is dependent on what the server is actually doing.

There's someone on the community forums that tried deleting and re-adding, but it changed all of their device names, breaking their automations and dashboards.

https://community.home-assistant.io/t/changed-plex-password-not-plex-integration-wont-work/455000/1

This scenario (resetting Plex account password and clearing all logins) is something that should be handled, IMO, and shouldn't require a delete and re-add.

> I had the same issue. The token used by the integration is no longer good and you need a new one. Delete the integration and then re-add it. The integration gets a new token during instillation. Now it is working properly again.

I re-added the integration and it initially worked. After a reboot, same issue.

It looks like the HA Plex integration is utilizing 2 separate libraries for Plex: plexapi and plexauth. It appears that the plexauth library only returns the authentication token and nothing else. It looks like the plexapi is also able to provide this token, so why is a separate library used for the token part? 

It looks like plexapi may handle the tokens better than the basic plexauth library, but I don't know that for sure.

This happened to me again.  After this happens, there isn't much we can do except delete the entire integration and start from scratch.  Maybe there's a way to allow us to add/modify whatever information is needed by the integration to work again without having to completely remove it and add it back?

review_comments: The provided tests do not seem to pick up this case?
Oops, you're totally right. A passing test != a good test 😄
